Programs & Schemes

Explore programs and schemes tailored to meet the evolving needs of the startup ecosystem,providing the right support and opportunities to drive progress and long-term impact.

Startups
Mentors
Investors
Institutions
Corporates
Students
Women
Early Stage Funding
A comprehensive funding support initiative designed to assist startups across all stages of their journey, from idea and prototype to market readiness and growth.
Incubation & Acceleration
Designed to nurture startups from early validation to rapid growth through mentorship, infrastructure, and ecosystem connections.
Coworking Spaces (LEAP)
LEAP Centres provide startups with flexible workspaces, ecosystem access, and growth support under one roof throughout Kerala.
Market Expansion
Designed to connect startups with national and global ecosystems through exposure visits, showcases, and strategic interactions.
Investments
Connect with the right investors and discover funding opportunities designed to match promising startups with growth capital.
Govt. As A Marketplace
Creating market access for startups by enabling direct government procurement of innovative products.
Find a Mentor
Gain access to seasoned mentors with real-world experience across industries and markets.
View Our Mentors
Explore a network of experienced mentors supporting startups with expertise and industry insights.
Become a Mentor
Share your expertise and guide startups by becoming a mentor in Kerala’s startup ecosystem.
Fund of Funds
To strengthen Kerala’s startup investment ecosystem by enabling capital flow into professionally managed venture capital funds
Ignite
Investor Education Program Enabling HNIs and Ultra HNIs to become confident angel investors through structured education, tools, and curated access.
Creative Economy Fund
A venture capital fund supporting creative economy startups across media, design, content, gaming, and cultural innovation.
Instruments
A key initiative that digitally maps scientific instruments across Kerala, creating a unified access ecosystem for researchers and innovators.
RINK
A collaborative platform designed to transform research outcomes into market-ready solutions, focused on advancing deep-technology innovation.
IEDC
Institutional platforms established across higher educational institutions to nurture creativity, experimentation, and entrepreneurial thinking among students.
Women Productisation Grant
An inclusive funding support designed to help women and transgender-led startups transform their Minimum Viable Prototype (MVP) into a market-ready product.
Programs
Focused initiatives dedicated to nurturing a strong, inclusive, and future-ready ecosystem for women entrepreneurs.
Business Development
An initiative focused on enabling structured collaboration between corporates and startups to accelerate innovation adoption and business growth.
Construction Innovation Hub
An integrated ecosystem designed to address critical challenges in the construction sector such as labor shortages, environmental impact, project delays, and technology adoption.

World Class Infrastructure

Emerging Tech Hub

A state-of-the-art hub empowering startups with advanced infrastructure, support, and resources to innovate, scale, and lead across technology sectors.

Unique initiative offering fully equipped workspaces at scenic destinations, enabling innovators and professionals to work, collaborate, and create in inspiring environments.

Voices from the Ecosystem

Real insights and experiences shared by startups, innovators, and partners across the Kerala Startup Mission ecosystem.

  • “Intelak collaborated with the Kerala Startup Mission and we were really impressed with the quality of the startups that pitched at the reverse pitch session. Such sessions create the platforms for startups and corporates to connect and explore partnerships on an eye to eye level.”

    Mia Jafari

    Program Manager,
    Intellak Hub, UAE

  • "Unlike other Accelerator programs, KSUM has a very strong foundation and network of startups. We had participated with them in the Reverse Pitch with Kerala startups where we interacted one on one with entrepreneurs of different and varied domains to participate in the Bosch DNA cohort. The program is very focused and follows a business thought leadership approach.
    Looking forward to partnering with KSUM on our next BOSCH DNA COHORT launch."

    Hemanth S M

    Head - Open Innovation & DNA StartupBosch India

  • It has been a fantastic experience working with the Kerala Startup Mission who do
    some amazing work for startups in Kerala by providing them support and connecting
    them to the right ecosystem who can help these companies not just grow nationally
    but also expand internationally to cities like London via stakeholders like us, London
    and Partners. I have enjoyed working with the team on joint events where they have
    been very proactive and collaborative

    Divya Bajaj

    Vice President, London and Partners

  • In Hitachi India, we believe in a more resilient digital ecosystem supporting business
    continuity and a high quality of life for its citizens.  In association with Kerala Startup
    Mission (KSUM), we accelerated a national innovation contest inviting startups from
    all around India to help develop innovative digital solutions supporting small
    merchants. We came across a constructively efficacious event and KSUM was
    remarkable in operational and managerial direction. The event has enabled us to
    explore more on the latent talent of the startup community in India, that could really
    thrive for impending associations.

    Dr. Hisashi Ikeda

    Corporate Chief Technology Officer,Hitachi India Pvt. Ltd

  • Strategic Allies Limited (SAL) has been working with Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM) for the last 18 months with the objective of finding innovative companies that are suitable for their varied technology challenges.We have found KSUM very easy to deal with and our business contact at KSUM is very approachable, as well as committed in ensuring the start-ups follow-up with the opportunities.  So far,  KSUM has always been able to find interesting companies to put forward!

    Diane Kolonko

    Innovation Partner Manager,
    SAL, United Kingdom

  • Kerala Startup Mission has been propelling the very essence of entrepreneurship
    across the state riding on the wings of innovation. Under the aegis of the Govt. of
    Kerala, the mission to create a highly sustainable startup ecosystem has come to its
    full bloom - Kudos to KSUM!

    Sruthi Kannan

    Head, Cisco LaunchPad
